assessments.composition: Large title establishes event, diagonal handoff supplies movement, separated lower block scans clearly; cream space gives image room.
assessments.image_treatment: Opposing sleeves and hands hold the same book stack. Coral cover and cream page edges remain recognizable. Minor right-hand palm/finger separation weakness; refine contact silhouette.
assessments.copy: All locked copy readable at 450 x 600; italic literary voice, bold date/time.
assessments.brief_fit: Clearest books-changing-hands depiction; welcoming palette and direct action; no university implication.

assessments.composition: Different central-title loop experience, but thick arrows dominate and title has less prominence.
assessments.image_treatment: Identifiable books suggest circulation; generic arrows and no recipients risk recycling interpretation. Add human transfers if pursued.
assessments.copy: Required cream-on-navy copy readable with effective lower information block.
assessments.brief_fit: Relevant circulation but people-to-people meaning indirect.

assessments.composition: Title, symmetrical figures and open book establish clear sequence; strong focal object.
assessments.image_treatment: Two stationary figures hold an oversized open book. Shared reading is clearer than giving/receiving; revise interaction if pursued.
assessments.copy: All required copy readable; tagline relates to shared-book metaphor.
assessments.brief_fit: Welcoming connection through stories, but lacks directional transfer.

reason: Direct visible book transfer with prominent title and readable logistics is strongest common-brief fit. Calmer cream preference is secondary to transfer action.
unresolved_limitations: PNG-only concept assessment did not verify native editability/live type/exports. Four calibration images are principles, not a required style target.

observations: Neon title/sun/grid depth; dusk layered hills and sky clearance; Wright lit faces and inward gestures; city shared perspective planes.
Hands depicts transfer; orbit circulation without people; bridge shared open book. All six full/use alternatives actually viewed.
